definitions.explanation: Describes a wide range of different types or kinds. A four-character compound emphasizing both quantity and variety.

examples.japanese: {多種多様|たしゅたよう}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多種多様|たしゅたよう}な⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A wide variety of organisms inhabit this region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多種多様|たしゅたよう}になってきた⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧だ。
examples.english: We live in an era when working styles have become increasingly diverse.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal four-character compound (yojijukugo) used in both speech and writing. Modifies nouns with な or stands alone as a predicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多種多様|たしゅたよう}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (a diverse range of products)
- {多種多様|たしゅたよう}な⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (diverse cultures)
- {多種多様|たしゅたよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ (to be rich in variety)

FORMS:
{多種|たしゅ} (many kinds) + ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧ (varied). Both halves reinforce the same meaning of diversity.
